items.name: Shaftwarden's Ring
items.lore: A silver ring stamped with a pick: a Shaftwarden of Ardagh.

items.name: Lamp-Bearer's Belt
items.lore: A Warden's belt with a lamp-hook. Every Warden carries a light underground.

items.name: Silverhand Torc
items.lore: A torc ending in two silver hands. Given to the Wardens Ardagh trusts with its silver.

items.name: Pickguard Bracer
items.lore: Iron and silver, made to turn a pick-blow. Or a sheevra blade.

items.name: Mantle of the Airgetlam
items.lore: Grey and silver, a silver hand on the shoulder - Nuada's sign. Only the Airgetlam of the Wardens wear it.
